# Mobile Design Rounds

> Free mobile system design interview case studies for Android and iOS engineers. They cover failure modes and are checked against official documentation where noted.

## Start here
- [Reading paths](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/start/): mid-level, senior and staff tracks, in reading order, through the case studies and guides

## Case studies
- [Design a chat app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/chat-app/): Outbox, safe retries (idempotent sends), and sync with WebSocket and push.
- [Build it: a chat app on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/chat-app/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design a chat app answer
- [Design a news feed](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/news-feed/): Paging, optimistic writes (show a change first), and keeping the cache fresh.
- [Build it: a news feed on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/news-feed/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design a news feed answer
- [Design photo backup and file sync](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/photo-file-sync/): Uploads that can resume, sync by blocks, and edit conflicts.
- [Build it: photo backup and file sync on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/photo-file-sync/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design photo backup and file sync answer
- [Design a pagination library](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/pagination-library/): The library API, generic types, and which requests go first.
- [Build it: a pagination library on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/pagination-library/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design a pagination library answer
- [Design an image loading library](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/image-loading/): Memory and disk caches, decoding, and cancelling requests.
- [Build it: an image loading library on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/image-loading/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design an image loading library answer
- [Design a hotel or ride booking app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/booking-app/): Holds, server time, payments, and search.
- [Build it: a booking app on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/booking-app/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design a hotel or ride booking app answer
- [Design a stock ticker app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/live-ticker/): Streaming updates, limiting how often the screen changes, and an always-online app.
- [Build it: a stock ticker app on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/live-ticker/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design a stock ticker app answer
- [Design a video streaming app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/video-app/): Loading ahead (prefetch), adaptive bitrate, and playback state.
- [Build it: a video streaming app on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/video-app/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design a video streaming app answer
- [Design an analytics SDK](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/analytics-sdk/): Sending events in batches, saving them on the device, privacy, and versions.
- [Build it: an analytics SDK on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/analytics-sdk/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design an analytics sdk answer
- [Design a push notification SDK](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/push-sdk/): How push tokens change over time, delivery, and deep links.
- [Build it: a push notification SDK on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/push-sdk/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design a push notification sdk answer
- [Design a travel plans app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/travel-plans-app/): Friends edit a trip together, even offline, and no change is lost without a sign.
- [Build it: an offline-first travel plans app on Android and iOS](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/travel-plans-app/build/): the schema, API, code and platform limits for the design a travel plans app answer
- [Design a public transport app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/public-transport-app/): A timetable that works offline, live delays on top, and careful use of location and battery. Free teaser; the full case is planned for the study pack.

## Case studies by topic
- [Offline and sync](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/offline-and-sync/): Apps that keep working with no network, and sync later.
- [Feeds and media](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/feeds-and-media/): Long lists, images and video that load fast and stay fresh.
- [SDKs and libraries](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/sdks-and-libraries/): Code that other developers add to their apps.
- [Live data and payments](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/live-data-and-payments/): Data that changes live, and actions that must happen once.

## Guides
- [Staff-level mobile system design: what the round tests](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/guides/staff-mobile-loop-guide/): How staff answers differ from senior answers, what interviewers can see, and a four-week practice plan.
- [Offline-first mobile system design: one model, six case studies](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/guides/offline-first-hub/): The official offline-first model (the app keeps working without a network) used for chat, feed, upload, booking, analytics and push.
- [Native vs cross-platform: write the decision record](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/guides/native-vs-cross-platform-decision-guide/): A staff-level decision record (ADR) for choosing a framework. It covers criteria, the assumption that would change the choice, migration, parity tests, libraries with no owner, rollback, and a free template.

## Practice tools
- [Practice tools](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/simulators/): a timer and three simulators that let you change one thing and see what happens
- [Practice timer](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/practice/): A 45-minute clock for a mobile system design round, with a prompt, five steps and a checklist.
- [Retry explorer](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/simulators/retry/): Change the retry rules and see if a lost reply makes a duplicate message.
- [Pagination race](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/simulators/pagination/): Change one thing and watch a list repeat or miss posts. Compare page numbers with a cursor.
- [Offline chat simulator](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/simulators/offline-chat/): Send a chat message with no connection and lose a reply. Watch the outbox and the server.

## Glossary
- [Glossary](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/glossary/): plain English meanings of 75 hard words from the case studies, such as outbox, idempotent, Doze and WorkManager

## Pack waitlist (not yet a product)
- [Pack waitlist](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/pack/): a planned paid study pack. It does not exist yet. There is no price, only a waitlist
